snippet.title: Base Boomers | Official Steam Announcement Trailer -
snippet.description:
Base Boomers is a chaotic physics-based destruction FPS game where up to 4 players build their own bases and try to blow each other's apart. 
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4661800/
